text:
maya: Quick sync — change window tonight 01:00-02:00 UTC. Goal: runtime -> v2.3.1, router -> v1.9.2. Need dependency map before we pin.
quentin: Ack. I pushed a minimal dep matrix to the release doc but we should call out console <-> runtime schema compatibility. rachel, do you have the console contract diff?
rachel: I do. Console will accept both old and new headers, but the header-split flag must be toggled. If we flip without a gradual handback we risk 502s on old clients.
maya: Good catch. Proposal: canary runtime on 5% with router unchanged, then router pin to v1.9.2 after runtime canary is healthy. If console flag fails, rollback runtime only.
zane: +1. Also add a short TTL on KV eviction change so we can revert quickly. Note: routing table rebalance could spike p50 for ~3m.
deploybot: [deploybot] Initiating preflight checks for runtime v2.3.1 -> canary(5%). Checks: infra capacity, model-quant compat, API contract. Use /deploy dry-run for details.
quentin: I'm adding a line in release notes: "Runtime v2.3.1: kernel batching tweak, header-split safe-guard". Also adding rollback criteria: error-rate >1% or p95 latency +50% for 10m.
maya: Sounds right. Can we add an automatic fallback policy to route traffic to runtime-v2-compat if canary spikes?
zane: We have a fallback variant pinned in Dedicated. I'll list the variant id in the release doc.
rachel: Console team will hold the header-split flag during canary. We'll only flip after router pin is successful.
maya: Timeline: T0=01:00 deploy runtime canary. T0+15m metrics check. T0+30m router pin to v1.9.2 and flip header flag if stable. If any checks fail, rollback runtime immediately.
deploybot: [deploybot] Preflight passed. Dry-run commands:
```
/deploy runtime v2.3.1 --canary=5 --dry-run
/deploy router v1.9.2 --pin=staged
```
quentin: I'll own the metrics watch. Maya you'll shepherd the rollback if needed?
maya: Yep. I'll be online and will post the rollback command in this thread if triggered.
zane: Add me for KV TTL revert. I'll prep the quick patch: `kvctl set-ttl shard=all ttl=30s` ready to run.
rachel: One more: update release notes with the console flag name: `ENABLE_HEADER_SPLIT` and mention we delay flip until router confirm.
maya: Great. I'll update the release doc and post the final pinned variant ids. See you at T-30. :thumbsup:
